title: 半径成等差的圆装入圆
titleEn: Packing circles of radius 1,2,…,n into a circle

knownBest.source: the circles of radii 1 and 2 must be 3 apart, while their centres sit at most R−1 and R−2 from the middle; the sum forces R = 3
the circles of radii 2 and 3 must be 5 apart, while their centres sit at most R−2 and R−3 from the middle; the sum forces R = 5
the circles of radii 3 and 4 must be 7 apart, while their centres sit at most R−3 and R−4 from the middle; the sum forces R = 7
